title: Add runs diagnose command
instructions: Implement bun run samantha runs:diagnose --run-log=<path>. Add the smallest deterministic core module needed, likely src/core/run-diagnose.ts, plus parser coverage in tests/cli.test.ts and focused behavior tests in tests/run-diagnose.test.ts. Read one worker run log, classify it using existing execution/evaluation signals already represented by summarizeWorkerRun, and print JSON containing outcome, failureReason when available, trustedWorkerOutput boolean, and recommendedNextAction. Passing writer runs should recommend runs:accept. Passing report-only runs should be reported as report evidence, not mergeable work. Setup failures should recommend fixing setup/task/environment and rerunning a new task. Worker command failures or malformed HARNESS_RESULT should recommend inspecting evidence and narrowing/rerunning only with explicit reason. Scope violations should recommend rejecting the output and creating a narrower task. Verify failures should recommend a rework task that keeps the failed verify command. Commit failures should recommend explicit local inspection and must not trust worker lifecycle. Keep the command explicit and local-only. Do not add retries, automatic task creation, lesson drafting, merge, cleanup, push, remote adapters, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, routine triggers, hidden memory, multi-project orchestration, or promoted learning artifact edits.
